Tobal 2 Widescreen

Default: disabled. Enable on the launcher's Mods page.

Choose fixed 16:9 or Adaptive. Adaptive follows the current window/fullscreen
aspect from 4:3 through 32:9.

The mod widens the 3D field of view, so more of each stage is visible on the
sides. FMVs and pure 2D screens stay 4:3. Disabling the mod restores the
original presentation on the next launch.
